observations.why: Directive issued in a settled, confident register — establishing cadence without urgency or alarm, conveying quiet authority and satisfaction.
Aphoristic warning carries urgency-as-worry: an unrehearsed rollback is framed as a loss, registering alarm about gaps in preparedness.
Restating the cadence as a settled label in a summary block conveys contentment and organizational confidence — low arousal, positive valence.
Naming the owner in a summary block is a settled, confident act of accountability — low arousal, positive valence.

mints.title: an unrehearsed rollback is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker registering alarm that a capability claimed on paper is not actually held because it has not been practiced?
